comment:
* A thread that has no permissions, is not a member of any user-defined
 * ThreadGroup and supports the ability to erase ThreadLocals.

variables.name: hasRun
variables.comment: ensure run method is run only once

methods.name: public static Thread newThread(Runnable target)
methods.comment:
* Returns a new InnocuousThread with an auto-generated thread name
     * and its context class loader is set to the system class loader.

methods.name: public static Thread newThread(String name, Runnable target)
methods.comment:
* Returns a new InnocuousThread with its context class loader
     * set to the system class loader.

methods.name: public static Thread newSystemThread(Runnable target)
methods.comment:
* Returns a new InnocuousThread with an auto-generated thread name.
     * Its context class loader is set to null.

methods.name: public static Thread newSystemThread(String name, Runnable target)
methods.comment: * Returns a new InnocuousThread with null context class loader.

methods.name: public final void eraseThreadLocals()
methods.comment: * Drops all thread locals (and inherited thread locals).

methodNames: public static Thread newThread(String name, Runnable target)
public static Thread newSystemThread(String name, Runnable target)
